steps.narrate: Claude reads the law corpus and writes one structured rule per provision, with a quoted span. A schema check rejects malformed records before they reach rules dot json.
An address goes to the Census geocoder, then to its state, county and city stack. Each rule's conditions are tested. A missing fact returns unknown, never a guess.
Every rule has an effective date and a status. The change log lists affected addresses and answers as of any date.
Not legal advice. Every answer is cited, corpus text is treated as data, and there is an audit log.
Our self-check scorecard, labelled as a proxy, then the change tests.
